entries.task_id: kom pu|ce|wvnenkvlelu cem zugu mew rume
entries.description: kom pu ce wvnenkvlelu cem zugu mew rume
entries.subject: kom pu
entries.object: wvnenkvlelu cem zugu mew rume

spans.text: Rvf kvme zugugelu am fey mew ta mvley tañi kvzawael kom pu ce fij mapu mew, pu fvxake vbmen, kom pu ce wvnenkvlelu cem zugu mew rume, pu wenxu ka pu zomo mvley tañi newenmayafiel ka wenuñpvramafiel tvfaci zugu az mogeleam kom pu mogen ce, fey mew ta yamgeay xvr felen ka nor felen tvfaci mogen mew.
Kom ce fij mapu mew mvley ñi kimgeael, wirintukulelu am ñi vy wigka zugu mew ("Personalidad Jurídica" pi ta wigka).
Kom femgey ce wigka ñi wirikon zugu mew ("Ley" pi ta wigka) fey mew kom pu ce pepi nvway tvfaci zugu mew.
Tvfeyci wigka norvmzuguwe ruka mew, kom pu ce mvley ajkvtuñmageael ñi zugu, tañi kimgeam ñi weza femvn kam femnon ka tañi kimgeam cumueci ñi feletuael ragi kakelu pu ce.
Kom pu ce mvley ñi kisugvnew miyawael xokiñke ce ("Estados" pi ta wigka) ñi mapu mew.
Kom pu ce pepi xipayay cem xokiñke ce ("Estado" pi ta wigka) mew rume ka kisu ñi mvlemum, welu ka pepi wiñotuay.
Kom pu ce pepi nvwkvleay cem az mogen ("nacionalidad" pi ta wigka) mew rume.
Kom pu ce pepi entuay ñi rakizuam ka zugu, ka pepi kimellafi kompvle cumueci rume (radiomu, telemu, wirinmu) ka pepi kintuay, ramtuay ka joway zugu tañi kvzawkvlenmu.
Kom pu ce kisu ñi gvnewmu pepi xawvay cem piei xokiñ ce egvn rume.
Kom pu ce xvr pepi konay tañi kiñe Mapu Xokiñ ce mew ñi cem kvzaw mew rume.
Kom pu ce cumgeay rume mvley ñi kom xvr kujigeael tañi kvzaw mew egvn.

spans.text: Cem ce rume wezakamekegelayay, kupafkamekegelayay.
Cem ce rume kimvñmagenole ñi weza femvn gelay cumuelu tañi zajuñmageael ka mvley ñi eluñmageael tañi igkawam.
Cem zugu mew rume inayawgele cem ce rume, tvfa mvley ñi gvnaytuniegeael ("asilar" pi ta wigka) cem xokiñ ce mew rume.
Welu cem ce rume pinole ñi konaeal cem xokiñ ce ñi kvzaw mew rume, gelay cumuelu ñi gagegeael.
Cem ce rume pepi konay logkolealu tvfeyci xokiñ ce mew nvwkvlelu Kiñe Mapu mew ("País" pi ta wigka) kam werkvaygvn kiñe ce kisu egvn tañi zujiel.

spans.text: Kisuzuam kvpa konle kake feyentun mew femay mvten, kvpa kimelle ñi rakizuam ka feyentun ka pepi kimelafi.

entries.description: Mapu Xokiñ ce mew logkolelu: Logkogey kom pu ce mvlelu fey ci xokiñmu tañi zuam
entries.subject: Mapu Xokiñ
entries.object: mew logkolelu: Logkogey kom pu ce mvlelu fey ci xokiñmu tañi zuam

spans.text: Tvfey ci Kiñe Mapu Xokiñ ce mew logkolelu: Logkogey kom pu ce mvlelu fey ci xokiñmu tañi zuam.
Tvfey ci logkolelu Kiñe Mapu Xokiñ Ce mew mvley wvlael ixofij keju tañi kvme feleam ka kvme mogeleam kom pu ce mvlelu tvfey ci Xokiñ mew.
Cem ce rumje penoloe kvzaw mvley tañi gvnaytunieaetew wvnenkvleci pu ce ixofij zugu mew, tañi Kiñe Mapu Xokiñ Ce mew.
Puwjenole tvfaci mogeam, mvley ñi kejugeael tañi Kiñe Mapu Xokiñ Ce mew.

entries.subject: Tvfa ci
entries.object: ce mvxvmmuway tañi zujiam ñi logko egvn

spans.text: Tvfa ci pu ce mvxvmmuway tañi zujiam ñi logko egvn, kom xvr pepi feypiaygvn iney tañi zuamniefiel tañi logkogeal.

entries.description: kejunole ñi pu ce mvley tañi kejuaetew kake Mapu Xokiñ Ce
entries.subject: kejunole ñi
entries.object: ce mvley tañi kejuaetew kake Mapu Xokiñ Ce

spans.text: Tvfaci logko kvme pepi kejunole ñi pu ce mvley tañi kejuaetew kake Mapu Xokiñ Ce.

entries.description: feleay ta pu ce

entries.object: ce

spans.text: Kom pu ce mvley ñi nieael kvzaw, mvley kisu zujiael ñi kvzaw femueci ta xvr feleay ta pu ce.

spans.text: Cem ce rumje penoloe kvzaw mvley tañi gvnaytunieaetew wvnenkvleci pu ce ixofij zugu mew, tañi Kiñe Mapu Xokiñ Ce mew.

entries.description: mogelneam ñi pu fvren
entries.subject: mogelneam ñi
entries.object: fvren

spans.text: Kom Kvzawci pu ce mvley ñi kvme kujiniegeael; tañi kvme mogeleam ka kvme mogelneam ñi pu fvren.

entries.description: Tvfeyci pu kvzawfe rvf kvme felenole
entries.subject: Tvfeyci
entries.object: kvzawfe rvf kvme felenole

spans.text: Tvfeyci pu kvzawfe rvf kvme felenole, yamvñmagenole ñi zugu egvn pepi xawvluwaygvn tañi kinewvn igkawam egvn.

entries.task_id: ñi zugu|egvn|pepi xawvluwaygvn tañi kinewvn igkawam egvn

spans.text: Tvfeyci pu kvzawfe rvf kvme felenole, yamvñmagenole ñi zugu egvn pepi xawvluwaygvn tañi kinewvn igkawam egvn.

entries.task_id: kom kvzawfe|pu|ce mvley ñi vrkvtuael ñi kvzaw mew
entries.description: Kom Kvzawfe pu ce mvley ñi vrkvtuael ñi kvzaw mew
entries.subject: Kom Kvzawfe
entries.object: ce mvley ñi vrkvtuael ñi kvzaw mew

spans.text: Kom Kvzawfe pu ce mvley ñi vrkvtuael ñi kvzaw mew, ka tañi zoy kvzawnoam, yamvñmageael ñi orario ka tañi kiñe mufv an

folded.id: az mogen|mew|kvpa femle egvn
folded.subject: az mogen
folded.object: kvpa femle egvn

spans.text: Iney rume mvntuñmagelayay ñi az mogen ("nacionalidad") ka pepi nvway ka konaygvn kake az mogen mew kvpa femle egvn.

folded.id: az mogengeayrume|mvlelu|fij mapu
folded.subject: az mogengeayrume
folded.object: fij mapu

spans.text: Kom pu xokiñ ce, cem az mogengeayrume mvlelu fij mapu, ka femueci xvr nvwkvley tvfaci Fvxa Cijka mew.

folded.id: cem zugu|mew|rume inayawgele cem ce rume
folded.subject: Cem zugu
folded.object: rume inayawgele cem ce rume

spans.text: Cem zugu mew rume inayawgele cem ce rume, tvfa mvley ñi gvnaytuniegeael ("asilar" pi ta wigka) cem xokiñ ce mew rume.

folded.id: cem|ce|rume wezakamekegelayay
folded.subject: Cem
folded.object: rume wezakamekegelayay

spans.text: Cem ce rume wezakamekegelayay, kupafkamekegelayay.
Cem ce rume kimvñmagenole ñi weza femvn gelay cumuelu tañi zajuñmageael ka mvley ñi eluñmageael tañi igkawam.
Cem zugu mew rume inayawgele cem ce rume, tvfa mvley ñi gvnaytuniegeael ("asilar" pi ta wigka) cem xokiñ ce mew rume.
Welu cem ce rume pinole ñi konaeal cem xokiñ ce ñi kvzaw mew rume, gelay cumuelu ñi gagegeael.
Cem ce rume pepi konay logkolealu tvfeyci xokiñ ce mew nvwkvlelu Kiñe Mapu mew ("País" pi ta wigka) kam werkvaygvn kiñe ce kisu egvn tañi zujiel.

folded.id: cem|ce|rumje penoloe kvzaw mvley tañi gvnaytunieaetew wvnenkvleci pu ce ixofij zugu mew
folded.subject: Cem
folded.object: rumje penoloe kvzaw mvley tañi gvnaytunieaetew wvnenkvleci pu ce ixofij zugu mew

spans.text: Cem ce rumje penoloe kvzaw mvley tañi gvnaytunieaetew wvnenkvleci pu ce ixofij zugu mew, tañi Kiñe Mapu Xokiñ Ce mew.

folded.id: feleay ta|pu|ce
folded.subject: feleay ta
folded.object: ce

spans.text: Kom pu ce mvley ñi nieael kvzaw, mvley kisu zujiael ñi kvzaw femueci ta xvr feleay ta pu ce.

folded.id: fey|mew|fvxa xawvn mew ("asamblea general" pi ta wigka)
folded.subject: Fey
folded.object: Fvxa Xawvn mew ("Asamblea General" pi ta wigka)

spans.text: Fey mew Fvxa Xawvn mew ("Asamblea General" pi ta wigka)

Rvf kvme zugugelu am fey mew ta mvley tañi kvzawael kom pu ce fij mapu mew, pu fvxake vbmen, kom pu ce wvnenkvlelu cem zugu mew rume, pu wenxu ka pu zomo mvley tañi newenmayafiel ka wenuñpvramafiel tvfaci zugu az mogeleam kom pu mogen ce, fey mew ta yamgeay xvr felen ka nor felen tvfaci mogen mew.

folded.id: fey|mew|mvley xvrvmzugu kom pu ce tañi kvme mogeleam kisuke ñi feyentun mew
folded.subject: Fey
folded.object: mvley xvrvmzugu kom pu ce tañi kvme mogeleam kisuke ñi feyentun mew

spans.text: Gewenonmu yamuwvn, zuamgewenonmu kvme felen, goymagenmu nor felen mvley re jazkvnkawvn: Fey mew mvley xvrvmzugu kom pu ce tañi kvme mogeleam kisuke ñi feyentun mew, kisu ñi rakizuam mew ka ñi wimtun mew ñi mvleal egvn.

folded.id: feyci|mew|zajufalnofule tvfeyci zugu gelay cumuelu ñi zajuñmageael fewla
folded.subject: feyci
folded.object: zajufalnofule tvfeyci zugu gelay cumuelu ñi zajuñmageael fewla

spans.text: Kuyfi iney rume weza femfule, feyci mew zajufalnofule tvfeyci zugu gelay cumuelu ñi zajuñmageael fewla.

folded.id: fij mapu|mew|tañi kimgen kvme felen kisugvnew felen xvr kvme mvlen
folded.subject: fij mapu
folded.object: tañi kimgen kvme felen kisugvnew felen xvr kvme mvlen

spans.text: Kimnieel fij mapu mew tañi kimgen kvme felen kisugvnew felen xvr kvme mvlen.

Ka kimnieel ñi rvf kvme zugugen, wenvykawvn kom pu Xokiñke Ce egvn, nuwkvlelu Kiñe Mapu mew ("Naciones Unidas" pi ta wigka): Tvfa egvn xawvlelu "Naciones Unidas" mew nuwtuaygvn tvfaci "Fvxa Cijka" mew kvme xvr norkvletuam ñi mogen kom pu wenxu ka pu zomo mvlelu ixofij mapu mew feyci, kom xawvci pu ce tañi werkvel ci Pu Xokinke Ce ("Estados Miembros" pi ta wigka) mvlelu fij mapu kom pvle kejuwayiñ taiñ yamfalafiel xvr kvme felen ka nor felen piwigvn.

folded.id: fijke mojfvñ|ce|wixapvraley ñi kvme felen
folded.subject: fijke mojfvñ
folded.object: wixapvraley ñi kvme felen

spans.text: Kom xipace, fijke mojfvñ ce wixapvraley ñi kvme felen, nor felen tvfaci Fvxa Cijka mew, cumgeay rume ñi zugun, ñi wimtun, cem azgeay rume, cem kimvn rume nieay.

folded.id: fvta cijka|mew|"constitución" pigelu
folded.subject: fvta cijka
folded.object: "Constitución" pigelu

spans.text: Pu wigka mew mvley kiñe ruka cew ñi norvmgekemum ixofij wezake zugu; fey mew pepi nvway kom pu ce tañi igkañmageam, yamvñmagenole tvfeyci nor zugu wirintukulelu fvta cijka mew "Constitución" pigelu, nielu kom pu xokiñke ce fij mapu.

folded.id: fvxa cijka|kom|mapu fijke az ce tañi az mogeleam pigelu
folded.subject: Fvxa Cijka
folded.object: Mapu Fijke Az Ce Tañi Az Mogeleam pigelu

spans.text: Wixañpvramgey tvfaci Fvxa Cijka Kom Mapu Fijke Az Ce Tañi Az Mogeleam pigelu.

folded.id: ka xokiñke|ce|ñi gengeael cemu rume
folded.subject: ka xokiñke
folded.object: ñi gengeael cemu rume

spans.text: Kom pu ce mvley kisu ñi gengeael, ka xokiñke ce ñi gengeael cemu rume.

folded.id: kake feyentun|mew|femay mvten
folded.subject: kake feyentun
folded.object: femay mvten

spans.text: Kisuzuam kvpa konle kake feyentun mew femay mvten, kvpa kimelle ñi rakizuam ka feyentun ka pepi kimelafi.

folded.id: kam ka|ce|pekanka lef konle ñi ruka mew
folded.subject: kam ka
folded.object: pekanka lef konle ñi ruka mew

spans.text: Wigka ñi wirikon zugu mew ("Ley" pi ta wigka) nvwkvley kom pu ce ka fey mew mvley ñi igkañmageael egvn kake ce zugukonle ñi mogen mew, kam ka ce pekanka lef konle ñi ruka mew, kom tañi felen mew ka wezaka zuguyekañmagele.

folded.id: kejunole ñi|pu|ce mvley tañi kejuaetew kake mapu xokiñ ce
folded.subject: kejunole ñi
folded.object: ce mvley tañi kejuaetew kake Mapu Xokiñ Ce

spans.text: Tvfaci logko kvme pepi kejunole ñi pu ce mvley tañi kejuaetew kake Mapu Xokiñ Ce.

folded.id: kimvn fey|mew|mvley tañi yamniewael ka epuñpvle kejuwael egvn
folded.subject: kimvn fey
folded.object: mvley tañi yamniewael ka epuñpvle kejuwael egvn

spans.text: Kom pu mogence kisuzuam mvlekey, kom cegeygvn, logkogeygvn ka piwkegeygvn, nieygvn kimvn fey mew mvley tañi yamniewael ka epuñpvle kejuwael egvn.

Pu wigka mew mvley kiñe ruka cew ñi norvmgekemum ixofij wezake zugu; fey mew pepi nvway kom pu ce tañi igkañmageam, yamvñmagenole tvfeyci nor zugu wirintukulelu fvta cijka mew "Constitución" pigelu, nielu kom pu xokiñke ce fij mapu.
Kom pu fijke ce reñmawengenofule gelayafuy ce kom mapu, fey mew ta pu xokiñ ce ("Estado" pi ta wigka) ka kom pu ce mvley tañi gvnaytunieael fijke fvrenwen ka reñmawen.

folded.id: kisu ñi|pu|fvren egu femaygu mvten
folded.subject: kisu ñi
folded.object: fvren egu femaygu mvten

spans.text: Kvpa niele kisu ñi pu fvren egu femaygu mvten.

folded.id: kom kvzawfe|pu|ce mvley ñi vrkvtuael ñi kvzaw mew
folded.subject: Kom Kvzawfe
folded.object: ce mvley ñi vrkvtuael ñi kvzaw mew

spans.text: Kom Kvzawfe pu ce mvley ñi vrkvtuael ñi kvzaw mew, ka tañi zoy kvzawnoam, yamvñmageael ñi orario ka tañi kiñe mufv an

folded.id: kom pu|ce|wvnenkvlelu cem zugu mew rume
folded.subject: kom pu
folded.object: wvnenkvlelu cem zugu mew rume

spans.text: Rvf kvme zugugelu am fey mew ta mvley tañi kvzawael kom pu ce fij mapu mew, pu fvxake vbmen, kom pu ce wvnenkvlelu cem zugu mew rume, pu wenxu ka pu zomo mvley tañi newenmayafiel ka wenuñpvramafiel tvfaci zugu az mogeleam kom pu mogen ce, fey mew ta yamgeay xvr felen ka nor felen tvfaci mogen mew.
Kom ce fij mapu mew mvley ñi kimgeael, wirintukulelu am ñi vy wigka zugu mew ("Personalidad Jurídica" pi ta wigka).
Kom femgey ce wigka ñi wirikon zugu mew ("Ley" pi ta wigka) fey mew kom pu ce pepi nvway tvfaci zugu mew.
Tvfeyci wigka norvmzuguwe ruka mew, kom pu ce mvley ajkvtuñmageael ñi zugu, tañi kimgeam ñi weza femvn kam femnon ka tañi kimgeam cumueci ñi feletuael ragi kakelu pu ce.
Kom pu ce mvley ñi kisugvnew miyawael xokiñke ce ("Estados" pi ta wigka) ñi mapu mew.
Kom pu ce pepi xipayay cem xokiñke ce ("Estado" pi ta wigka) mew rume ka kisu ñi mvlemum, welu ka pepi wiñotuay.
Kom pu ce pepi nvwkvleay cem az mogen ("nacionalidad" pi ta wigka) mew rume.
Kom pu ce pepi entuay ñi rakizuam ka zugu, ka pepi kimellafi kompvle cumueci rume (radiomu, telemu, wirinmu) ka pepi kintuay, ramtuay ka joway zugu tañi kvzawkvlenmu.
Kom pu ce kisu ñi gvnewmu pepi xawvay cem piei xokiñ ce egvn rume.
Kom pu ce xvr pepi konay tañi kiñe Mapu Xokiñ ce mew ñi cem kvzaw mew rume.
Kom pu ce cumgeay rume mvley ñi kom xvr kujigeael tañi kvzaw mew egvn.

folded.id: kom xawvci|pu|ce tañi werkvel ci pu xokinke ce ("estados miembros" pi ta wigka) mvlelu fij mapu kom pvle kejuwayiñ taiñ yamfalafiel xvr kvme felen ka nor felen piwigvn
folded.subject: kom xawvci
folded.object: ce tañi werkvel ci Pu Xokinke Ce ("Estados Miembros" pi ta wigka) mvlelu fij mapu kom pvle kejuwayiñ taiñ yamfalafiel xvr kvme felen ka nor felen piwigvn

spans.text: Ka kimnieel ñi rvf kvme zugugen, wenvykawvn kom pu Xokiñke Ce egvn, nuwkvlelu Kiñe Mapu mew ("Naciones Unidas" pi ta wigka): Tvfa egvn xawvlelu "Naciones Unidas" mew nuwtuaygvn tvfaci "Fvxa Cijka" mew kvme xvr norkvletuam ñi mogen kom pu wenxu ka pu zomo mvlelu ixofij mapu mew feyci, kom xawvci pu ce tañi werkvel ci Pu Xokinke Ce ("Estados Miembros" pi ta wigka) mvlelu fij mapu kom pvle kejuwayiñ taiñ yamfalafiel xvr kvme felen ka nor felen piwigvn.
Kom pu fijke ce reñmawengenofule gelayafuy ce kom mapu, fey mew ta pu xokiñ ce ("Estado" pi ta wigka) ka kom pu ce mvley tañi gvnaytunieael fijke fvrenwen ka reñmawen.
Kom Kvzawci pu ce mvley ñi kvme kujiniegeael; tañi kvme mogeleam ka kvme mogelneam ñi pu fvren.

folded.id: kom|ce|mvley ñi mogeleael
folded.subject: Kom
folded.object: mvley ñi mogeleael

spans.text: Kom ce mvley ñi mogeleael, kisugvnew feleael ka yamniegeael.
Kom pu ce mvley kisu ñi gengeael, ka xokiñke ce ñi gengeael cemu rume.
Kom pu ce mvley ñi nieael kvzaw, mvley kisu zujiael ñi kvzaw femueci ta xvr feleay ta pu ce.

folded.id: kom|pu|mogence kisuzuam mvlekey
folded.subject: Kom
folded.object: mogence kisuzuam mvlekey

spans.text: Kom pu mogence kisuzuam mvlekey, kom cegeygvn, logkogeygvn ka piwkegeygvn, nieygvn kimvn fey mew mvley tañi yamniewael ka epuñpvle kejuwael egvn.

folded.id: kom|pu|xokiñ ce
folded.subject: Kom
folded.object: xokiñ ce

spans.text: Kom pu xokiñ ce, cem az mogengeayrume mvlelu fij mapu, ka femueci xvr nvwkvley tvfaci Fvxa Cijka mew.

folded.id: kom|pu|zomo ka pu wenxu pepi kureyeway kvpa kvreyewle cem xipacegeaygu rume
folded.subject: Kom
folded.object: zomo ka pu wenxu pepi kureyeway kvpa kvreyewle cem xipacegeaygu rume

spans.text: Kom pu zomo ka pu wenxu pepi kureyeway kvpa kvreyewle cem xipacegeaygu rume, kekewme az mogen nieaygu rume.

folded.id: mapu xokiñ|ce|mew logkolelu: logkogey kom pu ce mvlelu fey ci xokiñmu tañi zuam
folded.subject: Mapu Xokiñ
folded.object: mew logkolelu: Logkogey kom pu ce mvlelu fey ci xokiñmu tañi zuam

spans.text: Tvfey ci Kiñe Mapu Xokiñ ce mew logkolelu: Logkogey kom pu ce mvlelu fey ci xokiñmu tañi zuam.
Tvfey ci logkolelu Kiñe Mapu Xokiñ Ce mew mvley wvlael ixofij keju tañi kvme feleam ka kvme mogeleam kom pu ce mvlelu tvfey ci Xokiñ mew.
Cem ce rumje penoloe kvzaw mvley tañi gvnaytunieaetew wvnenkvleci pu ce ixofij zugu mew, tañi Kiñe Mapu Xokiñ Ce mew.
Puwjenole tvfaci mogeam, mvley ñi kejugeael tañi Kiñe Mapu Xokiñ Ce mew.

folded.subject: mogelneam ñi
folded.object: fvren

spans.text: Kom Kvzawci pu ce mvley ñi kvme kujiniegeael; tañi kvme mogeleam ka kvme mogelneam ñi pu fvren.

folded.subject: ñi kimniegeael
folded.object: mapu mew nor kvme felen ka kisugvnew mvlen tvfaci rakizuam kvzaw mew

spans.text: Femueci mvlcy ñi kimniegeael kom mapu mew nor kvme felen ka kisugvnew mvlen tvfaci rakizuam kvzaw mew.

folded.subject: ñi rakizuam
folded.object: ka ñi wimtun mew ñi mvleal egvn

spans.text: Gewenonmu yamuwvn, zuamgewenonmu kvme felen, goymagenmu nor felen mvley re jazkvnkawvn: Fey mew mvley xvrvmzugu kom pu ce tañi kvme mogeleam kisuke ñi feyentun mew, kisu ñi rakizuam mew ka ñi wimtun mew ñi mvleal egvn.

folded.id: ñi zugu|egvn|pepi xawvluwaygvn tañi kinewvn igkawam egvn
folded.subject: ñi zugu
folded.object: pepi xawvluwaygvn tañi kinewvn igkawam egvn

spans.text: Tvfeyci pu kvzawfe rvf kvme felenole, yamvñmagenole ñi zugu egvn pepi xawvluwaygvn tañi kinewvn igkawam egvn.

folded.id: nieay fij|pu|ce gelayay cumuelu ñi mvntuñmageael ka takuñmageael
folded.subject: nieay fij
folded.object: ce gelayay cumuelu ñi mvntuñmageael ka takuñmageael

spans.text: Cem rakizuam rume cem feyentun rume nieay fij pu ce gelayay cumuelu ñi mvntuñmageael ka takuñmageael.

folded.id: nor felen|kom|pu reñmawke ce mew
folded.subject: nor felen
folded.object: pu reñmawke ce mew

spans.text: Tvfaci zugu ñi mvleken mvleyem yamvwvn ka xvr kvme nor felen kom pu reñmawke ce mew.

folded.id: nor zugu|mew|wirintukulelu fvxa cijka mew
folded.subject: nor zugu
folded.object: wirintukulelu Fvxa Cijka mew

spans.text: Ka gelay cumuelu ñi zoy fvxa zajuñmageael feypilenole fewla tvfeyci nor zugu mew wirintukulelu Fvxa Cijka mew.

folded.id: pu wigka|mew|mvley kiñe ruka cew ñi norvmgekemum ixofij wezake zugu
folded.subject: Pu wigka
folded.object: mvley kiñe ruka cew ñi norvmgekemum ixofij wezake zugu

spans.text: Pu wigka mew mvley kiñe ruka cew ñi norvmgekemum ixofij wezake zugu; fey mew pepi nvway kom pu ce tañi igkañmageam, yamvñmagenole tvfeyci nor zugu wirintukulelu fvta cijka mew "Constitución" pigelu, nielu kom pu xokiñke ce fij mapu.

folded.id: ragi kakelu|pu|ce
folded.subject: ragi kakelu
folded.object: ce

spans.text: Tvfeyci wigka norvmzuguwe ruka mew, kom pu ce mvley ajkvtuñmageael ñi zugu, tañi kimgeam ñi weza femvn kam femnon ka tañi kimgeam cumueci ñi feletuael ragi kakelu pu ce.

folded.id: tañi mapu|mew|wezakamekenole
folded.subject: tañi mapu
folded.object: wezakamekenole

spans.text: Gelay iney rume ñi koraltukugeael ka wemvnentugeael ka wemvnentugeael tañi mapu mew wezakamekenole.

Wigka ñi wirikon zugu mew ("Ley" pi ta wigka) nvwkvley kom pu ce ka fey mew mvley ñi igkañmageael egvn kake ce zugukonle ñi mogen mew, kam ka ce pekanka lef konle ñi ruka mew, kom tañi felen mew ka wezaka zuguyekañmagele.

folded.id: tvfa ci|pu|ce mvxvmmuway tañi zujiam ñi logko egvn
folded.subject: Tvfa ci
folded.object: ce mvxvmmuway tañi zujiam ñi logko egvn

spans.text: Tvfa ci pu ce mvxvmmuway tañi zujiam ñi logko egvn, kom xvr pepi feypiaygvn iney tañi zuamniefiel tañi logkogeal.

folded.id: tvfaci epu|ce|re kisuzuam pile egu mvten fey wvla pepi kureyewaygu
folded.subject: Tvfaci epu
folded.object: re kisuzuam pile egu mvten fey wvla pepi kureyewaygu

spans.text: Tvfaci epu ce re kisuzuam pile egu mvten fey wvla pepi kureyewaygu.

folded.id: tvfeyci|pu|kvzawfe rvf kvme felenole
folded.subject: Tvfeyci
folded.object: kvzawfe rvf kvme felenole

spans.text: Tvfeyci pu kvzawfe rvf kvme felenole, yamvñmagenole ñi zugu egvn pepi xawvluwaygvn tañi kinewvn igkawam egvn.

folded.id: wenvykawvn kom|pu|xokiñke ce egvn
folded.subject: wenvykawvn kom
folded.object: Xokiñke Ce egvn

spans.text: Ka kimnieel ñi rvf kvme zugugen, wenvykawvn kom pu Xokiñke Ce egvn, nuwkvlelu Kiñe Mapu mew ("Naciones Unidas" pi ta wigka): Tvfa egvn xawvlelu "Naciones Unidas" mew nuwtuaygvn tvfaci "Fvxa Cijka" mew kvme xvr norkvletuam ñi mogen kom pu wenxu ka pu zomo mvlelu ixofij mapu mew feyci, kom xawvci pu ce tañi werkvel ci Pu Xokinke Ce ("Estados Miembros" pi ta wigka) mvlelu fij mapu kom pvle kejuwayiñ taiñ yamfalafiel xvr kvme felen ka nor felen piwigvn.

Pu wigka mew mvley kiñe ruka cew ñi norvmgekemum ixofij wezake zugu; fey mew pepi nvway kom pu ce tañi igkañmageam, yamvñmagenole tvfeyci nor zugu wirintukulelu fvta cijka mew "Constitución" pigelu, nielu kom pu xokiñke ce fij mapu.

folded.id: wenxu ka|pu|zomo mvley tañi newenmayafiel ka wenuñpvramafiel tvfaci zugu az mogeleam kom pu mogen ce
folded.subject: wenxu ka
folded.object: zomo mvley tañi newenmayafiel ka wenuñpvramafiel tvfaci zugu az mogeleam kom pu mogen ce

spans.text: Rvf kvme zugugelu am fey mew ta mvley tañi kvzawael kom pu ce fij mapu mew, pu fvxake vbmen, kom pu ce wvnenkvlelu cem zugu mew rume, pu wenxu ka pu zomo mvley tañi newenmayafiel ka wenuñpvramafiel tvfaci zugu az mogeleam kom pu mogen ce, fey mew ta yamgeay xvr felen ka nor felen tvfaci mogen mew.

folded.id: wezake vbmen|egvn|mvley tañi xvrvmuwael tvfeyci wvnenkvleci pu ce zugu mew tañi yamgeam xvr kvme nor felen
folded.subject: wezake vbmen
folded.object: mvley tañi xvrvmuwael tvfeyci wvnenkvleci pu ce zugu mew tañi yamgeam xvr kvme nor felen

spans.text: Tañi mvlenoam kaiñetuwvn zugu, awkan zugu tvfeyci wezake vbmen egvn mvley tañi xvrvmuwael tvfeyci wvnenkvleci pu ce zugu mew tañi yamgeam xvr kvme nor felen.

folded.id: wigka zugu|mew|("personalidad jurídica" pi ta wigka)
folded.subject: wigka zugu
folded.object: ("Personalidad Jurídica" pi ta wigka)

spans.text: Kom ce fij mapu mew mvley ñi kimgeael, wirintukulelu am ñi vy wigka zugu mew ("Personalidad Jurídica" pi ta wigka).

folded.id: wirikon zugu|mew|("ley" pi ta wigka) nvwkvley kom pu ce ka fey mew mvley ñi igkañmageael egvn kake ce zugukonle ñi mogen mew

folded.object: ("Ley" pi ta wigka) nvwkvley kom pu ce ka fey mew mvley ñi igkañmageael egvn kake ce zugukonle ñi mogen mew

spans.text: Wigka ñi wirikon zugu mew ("Ley" pi ta wigka) nvwkvley kom pu ce ka fey mew mvley ñi igkañmageael egvn kake ce zugukonle ñi mogen mew, kam ka ce pekanka lef konle ñi ruka mew, kom tañi felen mew ka wezaka zuguyekañmagele.

folded.id: xafkiñtucen ran|mew|kuyfi reke
folded.subject: xafkiñtucen ran
folded.object: kuyfi reke

spans.text: Gewelayay xafkiñtucen ran mew kuyfi reke.
